problemStatement.formal: def erdos1057Conjecture : Prop := ∀ ε > 0, ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ x ≥ X, (C x : ℝ) > x^(1 - ε : ℝ)
problemStatement.plain: Let C(x) count Carmichael numbers in [1,x]. Is C(x) = x^{1-o(1)}?
whyMatters: Carmichael numbers fool Fermat primality test for all bases
Understanding their density is key to primality testing
Gap between known bounds (0.34 vs 1-o(1)) is enormous

proven: Carmichael numbers are odd (proved from Korselt + squarefree)
No semiprime (pq) is Carmichael (proved via coprimality argument)
Carmichael numbers are not prime powers
open: Proving ≥3 prime factors from first principles (card=2 case needs n=pq extraction)
knownResults.goal: Prove structural properties; main conjecture is OPEN

blockers: carmichael_at_least_3_primes: card=2 case needs extracting n=p*q from primeFactors={p,q}+squarefree
currentState.nextAction: Prove carmichael_at_least_3_primes by building squarefree_eq_prod_primeFactors infrastructure

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Converted carmichael_odd from axiom to proved theorem. Added 3 new theorems (korselt_two_primes_impossible, carmichael_not_semiprime, carmichael_odd). Reduced axiom count from 8 to 7.
insights: ℤ cast approach essential for Korselt divisibility proofs - ℕ subtraction too fragile
Coprimality of consecutive integers: Nat.coprime_self_add_one via rw trick
Squarefree + single prime factor → prime requires careful m>1 argument
carmichael_at_least_3_primes: card=0,1 cases straightforward; card=2 blocked on extracting n=p*q from primeFactors
mathlibGaps: No direct lemma for squarefree_eq_prod_distinct_primes (would simplify card=2 case)
Nat.dvd_sub' lookup issues - exists in some files but not always resolved
nextSteps: Prove carmichael_at_least_3_primes by building n = ∏ primeFactors infrastructure for squarefree numbers
Submit to Aristotle for remaining axioms (bounds, infinitely_many, korselt_theorem)
Consider proving carmichael_odd independently of ≥3 primes (already done in this session)
